an6.108:1.5: imesaṃ kho bhikkhave tiṇṇaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānāya tayo dhammā bhāvetabbā.
an6.108:1.7: kāyaduccaritassa pahānāya kāyasucaritaṃ bhāvetabbaṃ. vacīduccaritassa pahānāya vacīsucaritaṃ bhāvetabbaṃ. manoduccaritassa pahānāya mano sucaritaṃ bhāvetabbaṃ.
an6.108:1.8: imesaṃ kho bhikkhave tiṇṇaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānāya ime tayo dhammā bhāvetabbāti.
